title: Jude and the Debt
author: Mara Thackeray
blurb: Sable Nakamura, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
